name: custom-web-app-development-framework
description: A domain-agnostic, gate-driven application development framework: SDLC workflows, quality ratchets, a centralised theme system with enforced contrast, and runnable starter code.

scripts.audit:all: node scripts/par.mjs "theme-sync=node scripts/theme-build.mjs --check" "contrast=node scripts/check-contrast.mjs" "theme-assets=node scripts/check-theme-assets.mjs" "colors=node scripts/audits/check-hardcoded-colors.mjs" "testids=node scripts/audits/check-testid-coverage.mjs" "rules=node scripts/audits/check-rule-coverage.mjs" "columns=node scripts/audits/check-column-control.mjs" "fixtures=node scripts/audits/check-fixture-leak.mjs" "deadweight=node scripts/audits/check-dead-weight.mjs" "compat=node scripts/audits/check-backward-compat.mjs"
scripts.guard:test: node scripts/par.mjs "guards=bash scripts/hooks/guard-reachability.test.sh" "claude-hook=bash .claude/hooks/adapter.test.sh" "codex-hook=bash .codex/hooks/adapter.test.sh" "fanout=bash scripts/fanout-check.test.sh" "upgrade=bash scripts/upgrade.test.sh" "gate-timing=bash scripts/gate-timing.test.sh" "run-log=bash scripts/run-log.test.sh" "review-plan=bash scripts/review-plan.test.sh" "close-out=bash scripts/close-out.test.sh"
scripts.guard:install: node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('scripts/hooks/pre-commit-guard.sh','.git/hooks/pre-commit');require('fs').chmodSync('.git/hooks/pre-commit',0o755);console.log('installed .git/hooks/pre-commit — note: .claude/settings.json already wires the same guards for Claude Code sessions')"
scripts.audit:all:serial: node scripts/par.mjs "theme-sync=node scripts/theme-build.mjs --check" "contrast=node scripts/check-contrast.mjs" "theme-assets=node scripts/check-theme-assets.mjs" "colors=node scripts/audits/check-hardcoded-colors.mjs" "testids=node scripts/audits/check-testid-coverage.mjs" "rules=node scripts/audits/check-rule-coverage.mjs" "columns=node scripts/audits/check-column-control.mjs" "fixtures=node scripts/audits/check-fixture-leak.mjs" "deadweight=node scripts/audits/check-dead-weight.mjs" "compat=node scripts/audits/check-backward-compat.mjs" --serial
scripts.guard:test:serial: node scripts/par.mjs "guards=bash scripts/hooks/guard-reachability.test.sh" "claude-hook=bash .claude/hooks/adapter.test.sh" "codex-hook=bash .codex/hooks/adapter.test.sh" "fanout=bash scripts/fanout-check.test.sh" "upgrade=bash scripts/upgrade.test.sh" "gate-timing=bash scripts/gate-timing.test.sh" "run-log=bash scripts/run-log.test.sh" "review-plan=bash scripts/review-plan.test.sh" "close-out=bash scripts/close-out.test.sh" --serial
